AccountingAdjustment.description:
A signed EPS effect included in the source basis and removed at target.

Positive effects raise source-basis EPS; negative effects lower it.  Thus a
GAAP-to-adjusted mapping is ``adjusted = gaap - sum(eps_effect)``.
AccountingAdjustment.title: AccountingAdjustment

ActualResults.description: Issuer actuals for one quarter; unavailable fields stay null with a reason.
ActualResults.title: ActualResults

AttributionCandidate.description: One possible driver, traceable to both claims and their receipts.
AttributionCandidate.title: AttributionCandidate

AttributionConfidence.description: Calibrated ordinal confidence in an inferred interpretation.
AttributionConfidence.title: AttributionConfidence

AttributionWindow.description: Reaction horizons whose information sets have different uncertainty.
AttributionWindow.title: AttributionWindow

AvailabilityValue.description: Three-valued answer to ``available before the cutoff?``
AvailabilityValue.title: AvailabilityValue

BenchmarkReaction.description: The matched benchmark reaction used for arithmetic context only.
BenchmarkReaction.title: BenchmarkReaction

CalculationWarning.description: A visible limitation or missing-data condition in a calculation result.
CalculationWarning.title: CalculationWarning

CardMetadata.description: Generation identity of this card, separate from the earnings event.
CardMetadata.title: CardMetadata

ClaimLocation.description: A passage-relative, half-open character span and its stable pointers.
ClaimLocation.title: ClaimLocation

ClaimQuality.description: Completeness assessment of a claim, never a truth assessment.
ClaimQuality.title: ClaimQuality

CompanyOntology.description: Compact ontology identity; the full registry remains a package asset.
CompanyOntology.title: CompanyOntology

Conflict.description: A pair of differing observations and its explicit resolution state.
Conflict.title: Conflict

ConflictResolution.description: Auditable classification of a difference, without a winning value.
ConflictResolution.title: ConflictResolution

ConsensusEps.description: One EPS estimate with its provider and declared accounting basis.
ConsensusEps.title: ConsensusEps

ConsensusState.description: Consensus slots without provider selection or reconciliation logic.
ConsensusState.title: ConsensusState

ConsensusType.description: Expectation provenance; management guidance is never sell-side consensus.
ConsensusType.title: ConsensusType

CurrentPreEventState.description: Latest known state with every quantitative fact using ``MetricValue``.
CurrentPreEventState.title: CurrentPreEventState

Decision.description: Canonical card spelling of the typed Ticket 19 decision output.

decision_support_notice.const: Decision support only; not personalized financial advice or trade execution.
decision_support_notice.default: Decision support only; not personalized financial advice or trade execution.
decision_support_notice.title: Decision Support Notice

Decision.title: Decision

DecisionAction.description: v4 actions plus exact legacy spellings for persistence compatibility.
DecisionAction.title: DecisionAction

DecisionContext.description: Evaluation frame only; Ticket 1 does not compute or store an action.
DecisionContext.title: DecisionContext

DecisionNumericValue.description: Null-safe scalar retained for compatibility with the neutral v4 card.
DecisionNumericValue.title: DecisionNumericValue

EarningsQuality.description: Accounting reconciliation without an automatically invented recurring EPS.
EarningsQuality.title: EarningsQuality

EpsActuals.description: Issuer EPS actuals, keeping GAAP and adjusted values distinct.
EpsActuals.title: EpsActuals

EventIdentity.description: Explicit fiscal and wall-clock identity of the event being evaluated.
EventIdentity.title: EventIdentity

EventTimestampEvidence.description:
Bounded public-artifact timestamp evidence for a historical event.

This is not an issuer-release-time assertion.  It records the first
verified public artifact time available in the staged source receipt.

limitation.const: SEC acceptance timestamp proxy only; not an issuer earnings-release timestamp.
limitation.default: SEC acceptance timestamp proxy only; not an issuer earnings-release timestamp.
limitation.title: Limitation

EventTimestampEvidence.title: EventTimestampEvidence

EventWindowResolution.description: The date convention used by all event-return calculations.
EventWindowResolution.title: EventWindowResolution

EvidenceClass.description: How a receipt's claim relates to its underlying source material.
EvidenceClass.title: EvidenceClass

EvidenceReceipt.description:
Compact, typed evidence provenance safe to embed in a context card.

``source_ref`` and ``temporal_context_ref`` are stable pointers.  Provider
response bodies deliberately have no field here.  Derived and inferred
receipts instead point to other receipts in the card's registry.
EvidenceReceipt.title: EvidenceReceipt

EvidenceRegistry.description:
Typed, compact receipts and their bounded semantic claims.

Claims intentionally retain only an exact receipt-sized excerpt.  The
complete source body remains in immutable research memory, addressed by
the claim's source and passage pointers.
EvidenceRegistry.title: EvidenceRegistry

Expectation.description: One pre-result expectation for a named completed fiscal quarter.
Expectation.title: Expectation

FactTruthStatus.description: Factual assessment, independent of when the fact was available.
FactTruthStatus.title: FactTruthStatus

FiscalPeriod.description:
A fiscal period supplied with every numeric metric.

A fiscal year alone explicitly denotes an annual metric; a quarter adds a
fiscal-quarter identity.  ``period_end`` is optional source detail, not a
substitute for a fiscal period.
FiscalPeriod.title: FiscalPeriod

GuidanceEntry.description: A management statement and, when available, its eventual actual.
GuidanceEntry.title: GuidanceEntry

GuidanceValue.description: One management-issued target, retaining its original range semantics.
GuidanceValue.title: GuidanceValue

HistoricalQuarter.description: The five-stage record for exactly one completed issuer fiscal quarter.
HistoricalQuarter.title: HistoricalQuarter

ManagementGuidanceLedgerEntry.description: Card-field spelling for the complete management guidance ledger type.
ManagementGuidanceLedgerEntry.title: ManagementGuidanceLedgerEntry

MarketReaction.description: A factual market reaction, explicitly separate from attribution.
MarketReaction.title: MarketReaction

MetricObservation.description: One immutable, provenance-backed observation of an ontology KPI.
MetricObservation.title: MetricObservation

MetricSurprise.description: A transparent actual-minus-expectation comparison for a non-EPS metric.
MetricSurprise.title: MetricSurprise

MetricTier.description: Materiality tier used for KPI coverage and review.
MetricTier.title: MetricTier

MetricUnit.description: Units are semantic, rather than merely display formatting.
MetricUnit.title: MetricUnit

MetricValue.description: A numeric metric with non-optional unit, period, bases, and scope.
MetricValue.title: MetricValue

NormalizationMapping.description: Receipt-backed bridge between two explicit EPS accounting bases.
NormalizationMapping.title: NormalizationMapping

NormalizedMetric.description:
Canonical generic financial metric names.

Company-specific KPI names and provider aliases intentionally belong to a
later ontology/extraction layer.
NormalizedMetric.title: NormalizedMetric

ObservationClaimType.description: Semantic role of a numeric claim; unlike values are not interchangeable.
ObservationClaimType.title: ObservationClaimType

ObservationPrecision.description: Source-declared numeric precision, never guessed from prose.
ObservationPrecision.title: ObservationPrecision

QualityControl.description:
Persisted QC summary; detailed deterministic findings live in ``qc.py``.

Strings rather than a direct ``QCReport`` reference intentionally avoid a
models/QC import cycle while keeping the canonical JSON forward compatible.
QualityControl.title: QualityControl

ReactionAttribution.description: A bounded likely-driver interpretation for exactly one reaction window.
ReactionAttribution.title: ReactionAttribution

ReactionPriceSet.description:
Prices selected for documented post-event reaction windows.

``next_open`` duplicates the first post-event observation's ``open`` so
consumers of the canonical card do not need to infer that price from an
embedded daily bar.
ReactionPriceSet.title: ReactionPriceSet

ReactionReturnSet.description:
Signed decimal returns for AH and post-event reaction windows.

A null value means that its price window was unavailable or incomplete; it
never represents a substituted zero return.

next_session_open_vs_reference_close_pct.title: Next Session Open Vs Reference Close Pct

ReactionReturnSet.title: ReactionReturnSet

SemanticClaim.description: One coherent proposition with a bounded, exact source receipt.
SemanticClaim.title: SemanticClaim

SurpriseComparison.description: Provider arithmetic and normalized economic surprise side by side.
SurpriseComparison.title: SurpriseComparison

SurpriseLayers.description: Separate sell-side and prior-guidance surprise layers, never conflated.
SurpriseLayers.title: SurpriseLayers

TemporalClassification.description: Whether the historical observation is native or reconstructed later.
TemporalClassification.title: TemporalClassification

TemporalContext.description: Complete temporal provenance for one external observation.
TemporalContext.title: TemporalContext

TemporalState.description: Event-level cutoff and the observations classified against it.
TemporalState.title: TemporalState

Tier1Observation.description: One required issuer-ontology observation, including an honest absence.
Tier1Observation.title: Tier1Observation

_UnknownSafeNumber.description: A numeric slot that cannot turn an explicit unknown into false precision.
_UnknownSafeNumber.title: _UnknownSafeNumber
